component.name: Caffeine Applet
component.summary: Keep your system awake on demand

description.p: A COSMIC panel applet that stops your system from going idle or going to sleep. Left-click the coffee cup to start or end a keep-awake session; right-click to choose how long it should last.

Sessions run indefinitely or for a set time. Timed sessions show a live countdown in the popup and release the lock on their own when time is up, so there is nothing to remember to switch off. The duration presets, and the duration that left-click starts, are configurable through a self-documenting settings file.
An optional, opt-in switch keeps the system awake with the laptop lid closed. It is hidden by default, never activates on its own, and resets to off on every launch.

Uses the logind D-Bus Inhibit interface directly. The lock is file-descriptor based, so the OS releases it automatically if the applet ever stops. No child processes, no polling, near-zero resource usage. Works with systemd-logind or elogind.

description.p: Sessions now keep the screen on, and the Flatpak build follows your COSMIC theme.

ul.li: Fixed the screen still blanking during a Caffeine session on COSMIC: the session held only a logind inhibitor, which cosmic-idle does not read.
Redrew the panel icon so an active session is obvious at a glance: idle is now a hollow cup, active a solid cup with steam. The two states were previously almost indistinguishable.
Fixed the popup ignoring the system theme: it had no access to the COSMIC theme configuration and fell back to built-in defaults.
Corner radii, panel and popup colours, and the frosted glass effect now match the rest of the desktop.
The applet now picks up theme changes live, without a restart.

description.p: Timed sessions, configurable durations, and an optional closed-lid switch.

ul.li: Right-click the panel icon to keep the system awake for a set time, with a live countdown in the popup.
Timed sessions end on their own and release the lock automatically.
Duration presets, and the duration started by left-click, are configurable in a commented settings file.
New opt-in switch to keep the system awake with the laptop lid closed, hidden by default.
Reworked popup, grouped into sections and using the native COSMIC applet styling.
Fixed a missing symbolic panel icon in Flatpak builds.
Fixed broken screenshot links in the software-store listing.
